audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: False accusation, poverty, extreme curses, children/family imagery, death wishes, and vindication.

verses.restored: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

familiar.text: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

notes.title: Extreme imprecation
notes.body: Psalm 109 contains some of the Psalter’s most severe curses. They are preserved as ancient rage-prayer and must never authorize stalking, harassment, abuse, collective punishment, or physical harm.

modern.text: O God of my praise, be not silent.

original.text: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְ֝הִלָּתִ֗י אַֽל תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ

verses.restored: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

familiar.text: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

modern.text: For wicked and deceitful mouths open against me; they speak against me with lying tongues.

original.text: כִּ֤י פִ֪י רָשָׁ֡ע וּֽפִי מִ֭רְמָה עָלַ֣י פָּתָ֑חוּ דִּבְּר֥וּ אִ֝תִּ֗י לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר

verses.restored: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

familiar.text: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

modern.text: They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause.

original.text: וְדִבְרֵ֣י שִׂנְאָ֣ה סְבָב֑וּנִי וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֥וּנִי חִנָּֽם

verses.restored: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself to prayer.

familiar.text: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.

modern.text: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.

original.text: תַּֽחַת אַהֲבָתִ֥י יִשְׂטְנ֗וּנִי וַאֲנִ֥י תְפִלָּֽה

verses.restored: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

familiar.text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

modern.text: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

original.text: וַיָּ֘שִׂ֤ימוּ עָלַ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה וְ֝שִׂנְאָ֗ה תַּ֣חַת אַהֲבָתִֽי

verses.restored: Set a wicked person over him, and let an accuser stand at his right hand.

familiar.text: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

notes.title: Satan / accuser
notes.body: Hebrew satan here is a common noun meaning adversary or accuser, not necessarily the later proper-name figure “Satan.” The restored wording keeps the lexical sense visible.

modern.text: Set over him a wicked man; let an accuser stand at his right hand.

original.text: הַפְקֵ֣ד עָלָ֣יו רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝שָׂטָ֗ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד עַל יְמִינֽוֹ

verses.restored: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

familiar.text: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

modern.text: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayer be regarded as sin.

original.text: בְּ֭הִשָּׁ֣פְטוֹ יֵצֵ֣א רָשָׁ֑ע וּ֝תְפִלָּת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַֽחֲטָאָֽה

verses.restored: Let his days be few; let another take his office.

familiar.text: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

notes.title: Later citation in Acts
notes.body: Acts 1:20 later cites this line in relation to Judas. That reception history does not turn the entire psalm’s curses into a model for treating enemies.

modern.text: May his days be few; may another take his position.

original.text: יִֽהְיֽוּ יָמָ֥יו מְעַטִּ֑ים פְּ֝קֻדָּת֗וֹ יִקַּ֥ח אַחֵֽר

verses.restored: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

familiar.text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

modern.text: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.

original.text: יִֽהְיוּ בָנָ֥יו יְתוֹמִ֑ים וְ֝אִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָֽה

verses.restored: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

familiar.text: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

modern.text: May his children wander as beggars, seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes.

original.text: וְנ֤וֹעַ יָנ֣וּעוּ בָנָ֣יו וְשִׁאֵ֑לוּ וְ֝דָרְשׁ֗וּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

familiar.text: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

modern.text: May the creditor seize all he owns, and strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.

original.text: יְנַקֵּ֣שׁ נ֭וֹשֶׁה לְכָל אֲשֶׁר ל֑וֹ וְיָבֹ֖זּוּ זָרִ֣ים יְגִיעֽוֹ

verses.restored: Let there be none to extend mercy to him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

familiar.text: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

modern.text: May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.

original.text: אַל יְהִי ל֭וֹ מֹשֵׁ֣ךְ חָ֑סֶד וְֽאַל יְהִ֥י ח֝וֹנֵ֗ן לִיתוֹמָֽיו

verses.restored: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

familiar.text: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

modern.text: May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.

original.text: יְהִֽי אַחֲרִית֥וֹ לְהַכְרִ֑ית בְּד֥וֹר אַ֝חֵ֗ר יִמַּ֥ח שְׁמָֽם

verses.restored: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with YHWH; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

familiar.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

modern.text: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and the sin of his mother never be blotted out.

original.text: יִזָּכֵ֤ר עֲוֺ֣ן אֲ֭בֹתָיו אֶל יְהוָ֑ה וְחַטַּ֥את אִ֝מּ֗וֹ אַל תִּמָּֽח

verses.restored: Let them be before YHWH continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

familiar.text: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

modern.text: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.

original.text: יִהְי֣וּ נֶֽגֶד יְהוָ֣ה תָּמִ֑יד וְיַכְרֵ֖ת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם

verses.restored: Because that he remembered not to show mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

familiar.text: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

modern.text: For he never thought to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and brokenhearted, even to their death.

original.text: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֥א זָכַר֮ עֲשׂ֪וֹת חָ֥סֶד וַיִּרְדֹּ֡ף אִישׁ עָנִ֣י וְ֭אֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵ֨ה לֵבָ֬ב לְמוֹתֵֽת

verses.restored: As he loved cursing, so let it come to him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

familiar.text: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

modern.text: The cursing that he loved, may it fall on him; the blessing in which he refused to delight, may it be far from him.

original.text: וַיֶּאֱהַ֣ב קְ֭לָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵ֑הוּ וְֽלֹא חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה וַתִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנּוּ

verses.restored: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

familiar.text: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

modern.text: The cursing that he wore like a coat, may it soak into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.

original.text: וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ קְלָלָ֗ה כְּמַ֫דּ֥וֹ וַתָּבֹ֣א כַמַּ֣יִם בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְ֝כַשֶּׁ֗מֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: Let it be to him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

familiar.text: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

modern.text: May it be like a robe wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.

original.text: תְּהִי ל֭וֹ כְּבֶ֣גֶד יַעְטֶ֑ה וּ֝לְמֵ֗זַח תָּמִ֥יד יַחְגְּרֶֽהָ

verses.restored: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from YHWH, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

familiar.text: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

modern.text: May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.

original.text: זֹ֤את פְּעֻלַּ֣ת שֹׂ֭טְנַי מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְהַדֹּבְרִ֥ים רָ֝֗ע עַל נַפְשִֽׁי

verses.restored: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.

familiar.text: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.

modern.text: But You, O GOD, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name; deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion.

original.text: וְאַתָּ֤ה יְה֘וִ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֗י עֲֽשֵׂה אִ֭תִּי לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּי ט֥וֹב חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽנִי

verses.restored: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

familiar.text: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

modern.text: For I am poor and needy; my heart is wounded within me.

original.text: כִּֽי עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָנֹ֑כִי וְ֝לִבִּ֗י חָלַ֥ל בְּקִרְבִּֽי

verses.restored: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

familiar.text: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

modern.text: I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.

original.text: כְּצֵל כִּנְטוֹת֥וֹ נֶהֱלָ֑כְתִּי נִ֝נְעַ֗רְתִּי כָּֽאַרְבֶּֽה

verses.restored: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

familiar.text: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

modern.text: My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.

original.text: בִּ֭רְכַּי כָּשְׁל֣וּ מִצּ֑וֹם וּ֝בְשָׂרִ֗י כָּחַ֥שׁ מִשָּֽׁמֶן

verses.restored: I became also a reproach to them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

familiar.text: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

modern.text: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֤י הָיִ֣יתִי חֶרְפָּ֣ה לָהֶ֑ם יִ֝רְא֗וּנִי יְנִיע֥וּן רֹאשָֽׁם

verses.restored: Help me, O YHWH my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

familiar.text: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

modern.text: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your loving devotion.

original.text: עָ֭זְרֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי כְחַסְדֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, YHWH, hast done it.

familiar.text: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.

modern.text: Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O LORD, have done it.

original.text: וְֽ֭יֵדְעוּ כִּי יָ֣דְךָ זֹּ֑את אַתָּ֖ה יְהוָ֣ה עֲשִׂיתָֽהּ

verses.restored: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

familiar.text: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

modern.text: Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.

original.text: יְקַֽלְלוּ הֵמָּה֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ קָ֤מוּ וַיֵּבֹ֗שׁוּ וְֽעַבְדְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמָֽח

verses.restored: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

familiar.text: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

modern.text: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.

original.text: יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שׂוֹטְנַ֣י כְּלִמָּ֑ה וְיַעֲט֖וּ כַמְעִ֣יל בָּשְׁתָּֽם

verses.restored: I will greatly praise YHWH with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

familiar.text: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

modern.text: With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely; I will praise Him in the presence of many.

original.text: א֘וֹדֶ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה מְאֹ֣ד בְּפִ֑י וּבְת֖וֹךְ רַבִּ֣ים אֲהַֽלְלֶֽנּוּ

verses.restored: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.

familiar.text: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.

modern.text: For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.

original.text: כִּֽי יַ֭עֲמֹד לִימִ֣ין אֶבְי֑וֹן לְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵ֥י נַפְשֽׁוֹ

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Extreme imprecation is preserved but never authorized as behavior; no curse in this psalm permits harm to enemies, children, families, or descendants.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, acrostic structure, duplicate/reused psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
